Navigate: click moves the 3D cursor; wheel changes slice; drag adjusts window / level; Shift-drag zooms. Segment: target/background points create one adaptive proposal without accepting each point; circles show sampling radius, not guaranteed fill. Local CT seed commits 30–100 HU voxels immediately; legacy grow/shrink edit on release. Contour grow and the separate shape-aware grow work in CT/MR: hold to preview a local 3D region, pause at a likely boundary, then cautiously continue if still held; release commits the visible region. Neither method identifies anatomy reliably at weak borders. Mask cleanup previews erosion or opening separately; cyan marks proposed removals, which may include real thin blood. Review all planes and use Undo. Exclude marker affects only the separate legacy CT Propose fill below. Research only, never a clinical measurement.
